# Aman Katiyar (Aman Ktyr) - Portfolio & Engineering Profile

> Official portfolio of Aman Katiyar (also known as Aman Ktyr): Full-Stack AI Engineer, Solutions Architect, and Agentic Systems Specialist.
> Website: https://aman.ktyr.in/
> Contact: amankatiyar.tech01@gmail.com | Lucknow, UP, India

## Professional Overview
Aman Katiyar (Aman Ktyr) is a Full-Stack AI Engineer and Solutions Architect with 3+ years of experience specializing in building intelligent Agentic Systems, high-performance Web Architectures, and scalable SaaS platforms. He bridges advanced artificial intelligence (LLM orchestration, autonomous agent workflows, multimodal vision AI) with enterprise-grade full-stack engineering (React, Next.js, Django, Node.js, PostgreSQL).

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Artificial Intelligence & Agents**: Agentic Systems, Autonomous Agents, GPT API / LLM Integrations, Multimodal Vision AI, Prompt Engineering, RAG Systems.
- **Frontend Architecture**: React.js, Next.js (SSR/ISR), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP animations, Responsive UI/UX.
- **Backend & Distributed Systems**: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, WebSockets, Microservices.
- **Databases & Cloud**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Supabase, Firebase, AWS, Docker, Linux, Nginx, Vercel, Netlify.

## Featured Projects Built by Aman Katiyar
1. **FitStack (Gym Management SaaS)**: Comprehensive Gym SaaS with member/trainer tracking, automated billing, and WhatsApp API notifications (Python, Django, PostgreSQL).
2. **LoveNest (Private Couple Sanctuary)**: Privacy-first, end-to-end encrypted couple relationship management app featuring a custom GPT-powered AI assistant (Next.js, React, WebSockets, Node.js).
3. **Caption Brain AI**: Multimodal Vision AI platform transforming images into high-converting social media captions, viral hashtags, and SEO alt tags across 25+ networks (Next.js, Vision AI, Tailwind CSS).
4. **SimplyJob**: Advanced job portal platform featuring automated search filters, role-based dashboards, and scalable Django REST API backend (Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, React).
5. **GurukulSetu (School Management Ecosystem)**: Enterprise institutional management system handling admissions, examinations, fees, and attendance (Python, Django, PostgreSQL).
6. **Bhatt Square**: Corporate digital ecosystem for Bhatt Square IT solutions firm, built with SSR and interactive Framer Motion animations (Next.js, TypeScript).
7. **Sipher Web Tech & Sipher Web Academy**: Digital agency platform and educational ERP/CRM managing student lifecycle from lead to certification (React, Python, Django).
8. **Attend Stack**: Real-time attendance monitoring SaaS with activity feeds, shift tracking, and leave management (Next.js, Django REST API).
9. **Mafroosh & Storepilot**: Luxury decor e-commerce platform integrated with Storepilot admin dashboard (Next.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL).
